page_title: BAY 1-0 UNI | Bayern Munich v Union Berlin 24/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) for his blatant foul.
90+5' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+5' The referee is firm and issues Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) a deserved yellow card.
90+5' Having seen unsporting behavior, Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is the recipient.
90+4' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+2' Rough tackle by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Chris Bedia (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Konrad Laimer will be replaced by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich).
85' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

85' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
83' Dangerous play by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin). Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.

82' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Frederik Ronnow dived superbly to block a header by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Frederik Ronnow pulled off a remarkable save!
81' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' A cross into the box from Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin win a corner kick.
78' The substitution has been made. Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) has replaced Alex Kral.
78' Nenad Bjelica has decided to substitute Janik Haberer and he is replaced by Chris Bedia (Union Berlin).
78' The attendance for today's match is 75000.
76' A substitution has been made. Jamal Musiala is replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
76' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) replacing Kingsley Coman.
74' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
74' Nenad Bjelica is stunned as referee Frank Willenborg shows him a RED CARD.

72' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Manuel Neuer shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
71' A crossfield pass from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates.
71' It looks like Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) saw red with that tackle. Frank Willenborg won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
70' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 21:3.

66' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Frederik Ronnow!

65' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
65' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
64' Nenad Bjelica decides to make a substitution. Benedict Hollerbach will be replaced by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).
64' That will be all from Robin Gosens who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
63' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
62' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
60' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
60' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
59' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
58' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
57' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Bayern Munich players look gutted.
56' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Bayern Munich players aren’t happy.

55' GOAL! Superb work from Leroy Sane, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who beats Frederik Ronnow with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 2:0.
54' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
52' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips in a cross from the corner, but Frederik Ronnow is well positioned and punches the ball away.
50' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
48' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Frank Willenborg had an easy-decision to make.
46' 1 - 0 Goal! Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
46' Chance! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Dayot Upamecano comes off for Eric Dier (Bayern Munich).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Frederik Ronnow.

45+4' A nice pass finds Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic low shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Frederik Ronnow pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
45+3' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
45+1' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
44' The game is interrupted now, Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
43' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and unleashes a volley towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
42' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick, but Frederik Ronnow reads it well and stops the effort.

42' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
39' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
37' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
36' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
36' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
35' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
33' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
32' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
32' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Frederik Ronnow to make a comfortable save.
28' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
27' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
26' Nenad Bjelica is forced to make a change. Kevin Volland is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin).
25' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
23' The percentage of ball possession is – 76:24.
20' Frank Willenborg blows for a foul after Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post.
18' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
17' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich). The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayern Munich are going to take it.
16' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
14' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
12' The rebound finds Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the left post. That was a promising chance!
11' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

11' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow was alert and made a comfortable save. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
8' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
7' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

7' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Frederik Ronnow. What a save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

6' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
6' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) steps up to send the ball in.
6' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Bayern Munich get a corner.
4' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
3' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

The players are out at last! Union Berlin will take the kick-off.
